caption: The video captures a barefoot woman in a white tank top and pink trousers practicing before a floor-to-ceiling mirror wall in a studio with gray draped curtains, a wall logo, a standing fan, and a reflected ballet barre. She stands with her back to the camera in a wide stance, one leg extended to the side and pointed, facing her reflection. The figure on the left is the mirror image of this same dancer, not a second person. The arm bent near her chest and face then lifts, arches over her head, and rises toward overhead extension. The other arm, first stretched outward and downward, travels to rest near her hip before extending outward and upward. Her torso tilts and leans laterally while her head tilts back as the overhead arm ascends. This forms a curved posture. The wide leg stance and pointed side foot hold steady, with no foot lifted or placed. These changes echo in the reflection, and the movement flows as one continuous gesture.
